title: Data consulting
description: Consulting for SMEs and remote teams: data pipelines, AWS architecture, cloud cost optimization, fractional data lead, and automated Excel reporting.
lead: I work with small and mid-sized companies in Paraguay and with remote teams that need their data sorted out without hiring a full team on day one.

services.title: Data engineering and pipelines
services.text: I bring the data from your systems (ERP, e-commerce, spreadsheets, APIs) into one place, clean and updated automatically.

services.title: Cloud architecture (AWS)
services.text: I design or review your data platform on AWS so it's simple to run, secure, and easy to scale when you need it.

services.title: Cost optimization
services.text: We look at what you're paying for in the cloud and why. I turn off what you don't need and redesign what costs more than it's worth.

services.title: Fractional data lead
services.text: A few hours a week to set priorities, review your team's work and make technical decisions, without hiring a full-time lead.

services.title: Automated Excel reporting
services.text: That report someone builds by hand every Monday becomes a process that runs on its own and lands in your inbox ready to go.

process.title: Intro call
process.text: 30 minutes to understand the problem. Free.

process.title: Proposal
process.text: You get scope, timeline and cost in writing.

process.title: Delivery in stages
process.text: Progress you can see and test along the way, not a black box at the end.

process.title: Handover
process.text: Documentation and a session with your team so you don't depend on me.

cta.title: Want to talk it through?
cta.text: Tell me what you need and we'll see whether I can help.
cta.whatsappMessage: Hi Luis, I'd like to book a call about a data project for my company.
